academic.textKo: 국제 고교 학력을 평가하며 해당자는 영어 능력을 증명해야 합니다. 온타리오 전용 최저 백분율은 확인하지 못했습니다.

testing.text: UMD is test optional through Fall 2027 and is assessing later cycles. Fall 2028 policy is not confirmed.
testing.textKo: SAT/ACT 선택 정책은 2027년 가을까지이며 이후 정책은 검토 중입니다. 2028년 가을 정책은 확정되지 않았습니다.

satRange.cohort: Fall 2025 entering first-time students with SAT used as their reported admission test; university report gives 25th/75th percentiles.
satRange.cohortKo: 2025년 가을 입학 신입생 중 대학 보고서에서 SAT를 입학 시험으로 사용한 학생의 25·75백분위.

entry.unit: University admission plus separate LEP review
entry.unitKo: 대학 공통 입학 및 제한 전공(LEP) 별도 심사
entry.text: UMD explicitly says the preferred major does not affect university admissibility. LEP admission is reviewed separately; non-LEP choice is not an easier way into the university. Letters & Sciences does not guarantee later LEP admission.
entry.textKo: 대학은 희망 전공이 대학 자체 합격 여부에 영향을 주지 않는다고 명시합니다. 제한 전공은 별도 심사하므로 비제한 전공이 대학 입학을 쉽게 만들지는 않습니다. Letters & Sciences 입학도 향후 제한 전공 진입을 보장하지 않습니다.

applicantScope.text: International first-year admission; citizenship and secondary-school curriculum may lead to different document and English-proficiency requirements. Confirm Fall 2028 rules before applying.
applicantScope.textKo: 국제 신입학 자료입니다. 시민권과 고교 교육과정에 따라 서류·영어 요건이 달라질 수 있습니다. 지원 전 2028년 가을 입학 요건을 다시 확인하세요.

entry.text: Exploratory is available for students undecided about a major, with a goal to declare by the third term. Dance, film, music and theatre require pre-entry program acceptance. No lower university cutoff for Exploratory was verified.

notes: All twelve added schools lack a verified Ontario percentage admission threshold in the cited sources. Null is intentional; U.S. GPA requirements and profiles must not be converted into Ontario grades.
easierMajorVerified is false for every school. Documented absence of supplemental materials or presence of an undeclared route is not proof of a higher acceptance rate or lower academic floor.
University of Maryland and University of Florida explicitly do not give university admission advantages based on the preferred major; their entry notes must remain visible.

Tennessee general and international testing instructions differ in scope; seek written admission-office clarification before labelling general international admission test optional. Its release summary reports SAT-equivalent ACT ranges, which were intentionally not stored as measured SAT percentiles.

Virginia Tech 2025–2026 CDS was discoverable only with SAT section percentiles, not a verified composite range. They were not added together. Delaware facts report means, not a usable middle-50 range. Syracuse fillable CDS text did not expose field values in this research pass, so composite SAT remains null.
UMD 2026 rank uses the dated September 23, 2025 official CMNS announcement (#42). A dynamic facts page showed #49 under an inconsistent 2026 label and was not used.

Rank nulls mean no reliable 2026 National Universities primary announcement was verified in this research pass, not unranked status. SAT ranges describe historical applicants or enrolled score submitters, not admission minima or probabilities.
Fewer supplemental materials, lower eligibility requirements, and easier admission are distinct claims. No Ontario band × SAT combination can be called assured admission from these holistic sources.
